evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: AI sycophancy, the tendency of large language models (LLMs) to flatter users and affirm their beliefs, can undermine accuracy and contribute to misinformation, dependence, and overconfidence.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
